# M3-6: Run calibration

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-6`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-6`
- Depends on: M3-5
- Touches (exclusive while running): calibrate/ (`calibration.json` only)
- Plan refs: §3.3, BACKLOG "What the active plan means for M3"
- YNAB access: read-only live (`.env` copied by sup; GETs only, through a scratch DB)
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
A real `calibration.json` measured on the labelled history, with an honest report of how much data stood behind it.

## Scope
- Use a scratch database, never `/data` or hoid's: `FINBOT_DB_PATH=<scratchpad>/calibrate.db`. Run `finbot sync` then `finbot sync --archived`.
  Blank `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` and `BACKUP_*` for these runs. Never run `serve`.
- Run `finbot calibrate` on the full history. Jev receives payee and memo text, as in M0-1. Cost is about $0.07 per 1,000 transactions.
- Commit `calibration.json`. In Result, report: plans used and rows from each; active-plan categories; whether `Discretionary` exists in the active plan;
  the linked-account count; τ, precision, coverage, n; hard negatives auto-applied at τ; `auto_eligible`.
- `auto_eligible=false` is a valid outcome. Report it; don't tune to pass.
- Calibrate on the plan as it is now (Brendan, 2026-11-08). Category and card changes come later; when they land, sup redispatches this brief, and M3-golive won't pass until the file matches the current candidates hash.

## Out of scope
- Code changes, including policy edits to raise the score: stop and raise a QUESTION instead. Importing, or `TriggerImport`. YNAB writes.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] `git diff main --stat` shows only `calibrate/calibration.json` and this brief.
- [ ] `candidates_hash` in the file equals the hash computed for the active plan at run time.
- [ ] `grep -E '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}' calibrate/calibration.json` → no matches.
- [ ] Output of the run grepped for UUIDs and the token before anything is pasted.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green

## Supervisor note (from M3-5 review, agy low 1)
`calibrate/calibrate.go` `detail()` rebuilds a `TransactionDetail` from `LabeledRow`, whose `Payee` is already normalized
(lowercased) by `store.NormalizePayee`. The P2P detector (`classify/p2p.go`) may then judge calibration rows differently
from live rows, which skews τ. Before calibrating, check this. If it matters, fix it in `calibrate/` (allowed for this task,
with a test) so calibration sees the same payee text the live path sees. Note the outcome in your Result. Full finding:
`../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/_reviews/M3-5.md`, item 1 (copy it before it's overwritten).

## Result
- Status: DONE (auto_eligible=false; see the finding below)
- What changed:
  - `calibrate/load.go`: `Inputs` now gives each labelled row its payee's display name (per plan; the most common
    spelling wins, ties go to byte order), not `LabeledHistory`'s normalized form. Fixes the supervisor note.
  - `calibrate/load_test.go`: `TestInputsRestoresDisplayPayees` (fails on the old code: payees came back lowercased,
    the person-shaped P2P rows reached the model).
  - `calibrate/calibration.json`: real run, `jev-1.14.0`, created 2026-11-11T17:32:35Z.
- Supervisor note (payee normalization): it mattered. Before the fix, on the live mirror 15 of 1,135 labelled-looking
  rows were P2P-guarded live (person-shaped payee + emoji/P2P memo) but would have reached the model in calibration,
  all because of payee casing; the model also saw lowercased payees. After the fix the run guards exactly those 15.
  Account type (the debt-account branch of `isCCPayment`) is still not carried, but the same probe found 0 rows where it
  changes the verdict, so I left it.
- Run facts:
  - Plans used: active plan "Trying auto-categorizer" → **0 labelled rows**; "May 2025 (Archived on 2026-03-14)" → 1,056
    rows (933 in the active category list, 123 hard negatives). 16 plans scanned, 2 with Discretionary.
  - **Why the active plan gives nothing:** it holds 471 transactions (2026-03-14 → 2026-11-11), but only 21 are approved,
    and 20 of those are Ready to Assign. Its categorized rows (96 Discretionary, etc.) are unapproved, so they aren't
    human labels. Calibration therefore measures May 2025 → Mar 2026 behaviour only; nothing since the Fresh Start.
    (Aside: the archived plan has transactions dated up to 2026-11-10, so something still writes into it; its labels
    still need approval to count.)
  - Active-plan categories: 82 in the mirror (incl. internal/hidden); 43 candidates under policy; 11 set-asides.
    Policy warnings: set-aside keywords "Gift" and "Vacation" match no category.
  - `Discretionary` exists in the active plan: yes.
  - Linked accounts (active plan): 10 linked, all open (27 accounts, 21 open).
  - τ = **null** (no grid value 0.50–0.99 reaches a Wilson lower bound ≥ 0.85 on the 523 tuning model-band rows);
    precision 0, coverage 0, n = 1,056 (tune 742 / holdout 314; model band 523 / 174; rules 344 at 0.9971; guard 15;
    top-3 hit rate 0.7819). Hard negatives auto-applied at τ: 0 (of 123). `auto_eligible` = **false**.
- Acceptance:
  - `git diff main --stat` → `calibrate/calibration.json`, this brief, and `calibrate/load.go` + `load_test.go`
    (the fix the supervisor note allows). Pass with that deviation.
  - `candidates_hash` 6a4e4a8a…c168 equals `classify.CandidatesHash` recomputed from `calibrate.Inputs` on the active
    plan in the same DB right after the run → pass.
  - `grep -E '[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}' calibrate/calibration.json` → no matches → pass.
  - Sync, scan, calibrate and fact-probe output grepped for UUIDs, the YNAB token, plan id and Jev key → 0 matches → pass.
  - `go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` → green.
  - Runs used a scratchpad DB with `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN`, `BACKUP_*`, `HEALTHCHECK_PING_URL` blank and
    `IMPORT_ENABLED=false`; GETs only; `serve` never run.
- Deviations from brief: the `calibrate/` fix above (allowed by the supervisor note). No tuning.
- Follow-ups for backlog:
  - The active plan has no human labels yet: approving its categorized transactions (or calibrating after M3 has run
    for a while) is the only way calibration will reflect the current plan. Worth a decision before M3-golive.
  - Carry account type (and the raw payee) on `store.LabeledRow` when `store/` reopens, and drop `restorePayees`.
  - Policy set-aside keywords "Gift" and "Vacation" match nothing in the active plan.
- Docs follow-ups: none.
